REVENUE DEPARTMENT, GOVT. OF NCT OF DELHI 
GUIDELINES FOR ISSUANCE OFSC/STCERTIFICATE 
 
A. Eligibility Criteria 
The applicant is entitled forSC /ST Certificateif 
 An Individual who is a citizen of India. 
 An Applicant should belong to a caste which is mentioned in the constitution (S cheduled Castes / Scheduled 
Tribes) [(States/Union Territories)] orders issued till date as amended from time to time. 
 Applicant must belong to at least one of the category as specified in Section B from S.No. 5 to 11. 
 Anyone who does not belong to SC or ST category can’t claim so on the virtue of marriage. 
B. Documentsto be attached with the  Application Form 
1. Identity Proof of Parents (in case applying for minor) ( Any Oneis mandatory) – 
 Aadhaar Card  PAN Card  Ration Card with Photo 
 Voter ID Card  Passport   Driving License 
 Any Govt. issued document  
 
2. Identity Proof of Beneficiary (Any One is mandatory) – Same as the List in Col 1 above. For a minor, the letter from the 
School Principal (on letter head) or birth certificate in case of a minor less than 5 years of age would also be acceptable 
3. Present Address Proof of Beneficiary or Parents in case of minor( Any Oneis mandatory) – 
 Aadhaar Card  Voter ID Card  Driving License 
 Passport   Ration Card  Rent Agreement (Registered ) 
 Bank Passbook  Electricity Bill  Water Bill 
 Telephone Bill(Landline or Post-paid)  Gas Bill  Any Govt. issued document 
 
4. Permanent Address Proof of Beneficiary /Parents in case of minor (Any Oneis mandatory) –Same as List in Col No 
3above. 
5. Case I:Original resident With Certificate 
Applicant whose family has been staying in Delhi since prior to 1951;  
AND 
           Where a caste certificate has been issued to any of his/her relatives from paternal side 
Applicant will be eligible for Delhi State SC certificate 
Following Mandatory documents would be required: 
1. Completed application form. 
2. Copy of Caste Certificate of any relative from paternal side.  
3. Proof of relationship of the applicant with caste certificate holder. 
4. One photo ID proof as per s.no. 1 or 2or both and  
5. One residential proofas per s.no. 3 
 
6. Case II:  Migrated & Settled in Delhi with Certificate 
Applicant whose family has migrated to Delhi  after 1951 and  domiciled here and belongs to a  Caste which is notified as 
SC/ST in the State of origin as well as in Delhi 
AND 
Where a caste certificate has already been issued to any of his/her relatives from paternal side; 
Applicant will be eligible for Delhi State SC certificate 
Following Mandatory documents would be required: 
1. Completed application form. 
2. Copy of Caste Certificate of any relative from paternal side.  
3. Proof of relationship of the applicant with caste certificate holder. 
4. One photo ID proof as per s.no. 1 or 2or both and  
5. One residential proofas per s.no. 3 
6. Any one of the following documents: 
a. Birth certificate for applicants born in Delhi. 
b. Matriculation certificate/marks-sheet for applicants who have studied in Delhi. 
c. Proof of residence for the last 5 years 
 
  7. Case III: Migrated & Settled(but not listed as SC in Delhi) with Certificate 
Applicant whose family migrated to Delhi after 1951 and settled/domiciled in Delhi and belongs to a Caste which is notified 
as SC/ST in the State of origin but not in Delhi; 
AND 
Where a Caste Certificate has been issued to these SC/ST applicants 
Applicant will be eligible for Other State SC/ST certificate 
Following Mandatory documents would be required: 
1. Completed application form  
2. Copy of the Caste Certificate of the relative from paternal side issued from Delhi or State of origin of the applicant.  
3. Proof of relationship of the applicant with caste certificate holder. 
4. One photo ID proof as per s.no. 1 or 2or both and  
5. One residential proofas per s.no. 3 
8. Case IV: Resident of Delhi but not settled in Delhi with Certificate issued to Paternal relatives in native state 
Applicant whose family has recently migrated to Delhi and the applicants belong to a Caste which is notified a 
SC/ST in the state of origin(It may or may not be listed as SC/ST in Delhi) 
AND 
Where a caste certificate has been issued to any of his/her relatives from parental side. 
Applicant will be eligible for other State SC/ST certificate 
Following Mandatory documents would be required: 
1. Completed application form  
2. Copy of the Caste Certificate of the relative from paternal side issued from Delhi or State of origin of the applicant.  
3. Proof of relationship of the applicant with caste certificate holder. 
4. One photo ID proof as per s.no. 1 or 2or both and  
5. One residential proofas per s.no. 3 
9. Case V:  Original resident of Delhi without Certificate to any Paternal relative 
Applicant whose family has been staying in Delhi since prior to 1951.  
AND 
Where no caste certificate has ever been issued to any of his/her relatives from paternal side; 
Applicant will be eligible for Delhi State SC certificate 
Following Mandatory documents would be required: 
1. Completed application form  
2. Proof of residence in Delhi clearly showing residence in Delhi prior to 1951 
3. One photo ID proof as per s.no. 1 or 2 or both and  
4. One residential proof as per s.no. 3     
Note: : Field verification will be mandatory in this case and will be conducted by an officer not below the rank of Naib Tehsildar 
10. Case VI:Migrated without certificate 
Applicant Whose family has migrated and settled in Delhi after 1951; 
AND 
Where no caste certificate has ever been issued to any of his/her relatives from paternal side; 
Applicant will be eligible for Other State SC/ST or Delhi SC/ST 
Following Mandatory documents would be required: 
1. Completed application form  
2. One photo ID proof; and     
3. One residential proof          
4. Any one of the following documents: 
a. Birth certificate for applicants born in Delhi. 
b. Matriculation certificate/marks-sheet for applicants who have studied in Delhi. 
c. Proof of residence for the last 5 years 
5. Applicant will be required to submit proof of residence in state of origin prior to 1951. 
Note: : Field verification will be mandatory and will be conducted by an officer not below the rank of Naib Tehsildar 
11. One Passport size Coloured Photograph of the Applicant(Size 5cm x 4.5cm Or 2”x1.75”) 
 Should include full face, front view and open eyes   should be of full head from top of hair to shoulder  
 should be in a plain white or off-white background  shouldn’t be shadows on the face or background 
 should have a natural expression (closed mouth)  should not include sunglasses or hats 
  C. Important Note 
 Parents can only apply in case of minor(“minor” as per the provisions of the Indian Majority Act, 1875) 
 In case of minor, parent’s Address proof has to be appended. The ID proof has to be of minor. 
 Beneficiary’s/Parent’sself-attested copy of the original document to be produced while applying at Citizen Service 
Centre (CSC)and if applying online then document are to be uploaded in e -District application software.  Physical 
verification of some documents may be necessary at the counter even in case of online applications. 
 Scanned copy of Self-Declaration has to be uploaded while applying online and self-declaration has to be submitted to 
the concerned SDM/Tehsildar/CSC by hand or speed post/registered post  along with Application 
/Acknowledgement number. 
 The beneficiary himself/herself  /any of his family member  should be present at the CSC for photograph or submit 
his/her photograph. In case of online application, applicant must upload beneficiary photograph (As per 
specifications above) 
 Details of all the persons to whom certificate has been issued will be put in the public domain and legal 
action will be ta ken against those applicants who have been issued SC/ST certificate by furnishing wrong 
information as per Section 177, 199 and 193 of IPC.
